"""Generate quiz visualization figures for the 2023 Physics Olympiad slides.
Run from this directory:  python3 _make_quiz.py
"""
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrow, FancyArrowPatch, Rectangle, Circle, Arc, Polygon, Wedge
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import os

OUT = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.size": 11,
    "font.family": "DejaVu Sans",
    "axes.linewidth": 0.8,
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.dpi": 160,
})

def save(fig, name):
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(OUT, name), dpi=160, bbox_inches="tight",
                facecolor="white")
    plt.close(fig)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Quiz 1B: Wall Bounce in a Frame
# A ball moving North at v0 hits a wall moving West at vp that makes a
# 45-degree angle with East. Show the velocity decomposition.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def fig_quiz1b():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 6))
    ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.axis("off")
    ax.set_xlim(-3.5, 3.5); ax.set_ylim(-2.5, 4.0)

    # Draw wall (tilted 45 deg to horizontal, pointing NW)
    theta = np.deg2rad(45)
    L = 5.0
    # Wall: from top-left to bottom-right (NW-SE direction)
    wall_pts = np.array([
        [-L*np.cos(theta), L*np.sin(theta)],
        [L*np.cos(theta), -L*np.sin(theta)],
    ])
    ax.plot(wall_pts[:, 0], wall_pts[:, 1], color="#555555", lw=4, solid_capstyle="round")
    ax.plot(wall_pts[:, 0], wall_pts[:, 1], color="#aaaaaa", lw=2.5)
    ax.text(-3.0, 3.0, "wall (45° to E)", color="#555555", fontsize=10)

    # Wall normal direction (perpendicular to wall, pointing NE = direction ball approaches)
    nx, ny = np.cos(theta), np.sin(theta)  # Normal pointing toward approaching ball
    # Draw wall normal arrow
    ax.annotate("", xy=(1.8*nx, 1.8*ny), xytext=(0, 0),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2.5, color="#cc6677"))
    ax.text(1.5*nx+0.1, 1.5*ny+0.1, r"$\hat N$ (wall normal)", color="#cc6677", fontsize=11)

    # Draw tangent direction (perpendicular to normal, along wall)
    tx, ty = -np.sin(theta), np.cos(theta)  # Tangent direction (along wall, NE)
    ax.annotate("", xy=(1.5*tx, 1.5*ty), xytext=(0, 0),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2.0, color="#4477aa", ls="--"))
    ax.text(1.3*tx, 1.3*ty, r"$\hat T$ (wall tangent)", color="#4477aa", fontsize=10)

    # Ball velocity in ground frame: v0 North (0, v0)
    v0 = 2.0
    ax.annotate("", xy=(0, v0), xytext=(0, 0),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2.5, color="#117733"))
    ax.text(0.15, v0/2, r"$v_0\,\hat N$", color="#117733", fontsize=11)

    # Wall velocity in ground frame: vp West (-vp, 0)
    vp = 1.2
    ax.annotate("", xy=(-vp, 0), xytext=(0, 0),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2.5, color="#cc6677"))
    ax.text(-vp/2-0.3, 0.2, r"$v_p\,\hat E$", color="#cc6677", fontsize=11)

    # Ball velocity relative to wall: v0 N + vp E (sum)
    ax.annotate("", xy=(vp, v0), xytext=(0, 0),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2.5, color="#882255"))
    ax.text(vp+0.1, v0/2, r"$\vec u = v_0\hat N + v_p\hat E$", color="#882255", fontsize=11)

    # Show parallelogram
    ax.plot([0, 0, vp, vp], [0, v0, 0, v0], color="grey", lw=0.8, ls=":")

    # Normal component of u
    u_n = vp*np.cos(theta) + v0*np.cos(theta)
    ax.annotate("", xy=(u_n*np.cos(theta), u_n*np.sin(theta)), xytext=(0, 0),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=1.5, color="orange", ls="-."))
    ax.text(u_n*np.cos(theta)/2+0.1, u_n*np.sin(theta)/2,
            r"$u\cos45° = \frac{v_0+v_p}{\sqrt2}$", color="orange", fontsize=9)

    # Ball position marker
    ax.plot(vp, v0, "o", ms=10, color="#882255", zorder=10)
    ax.text(vp+0.15, v0+0.1, "ball (in wall frame)", color="#882255", fontsize=9)

    # Axis labels
    ax.annotate("", xy=(3.2, 0), xytext=(-0.1, 0),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=1, color="grey"))
    ax.annotate("", xy=(0, 3.8), xytext=(0, -0.1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=1, color="grey"))
    ax.text(3.2, -0.2, "E", fontsize=10, color="grey")
    ax.text(0.1, 3.7, "N", fontsize=10, color="grey")

    ax.set_title(r"Quiz 1B: Ball velocity in wall's rest frame\n"
                 r"$\vec u = v_0\hat N + v_p\hat E$; "
                 r"normal speed $= u\cos45° = \frac{v_0+v_p}{\sqrt2}$",
                 fontsize=11)
    fig.tight_layout()
    save(fig, "quiz_1b.png")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Quiz 1C: Wall Bounce 2D Elastic Reflection
# Ball at 10 m/s hits smooth wall at 30 deg to wall surface.
# Show angle of incidence = angle of reflection.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def fig_quiz1c():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
    ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.axis("off")
    ax.set_xlim(-1, 9); ax.set_ylim(-2, 6)

    # Draw wall (horizontal line)
    ax.plot([-0.5, 9], [3, 3], color="#555555", lw=4, solid_capstyle="round")
    ax.plot([-0.5, 9], [3, 3], color="#aaaaaa", lw=2.5)
    ax.text(8.5, 3.2, "smooth wall", color="#555555", fontsize=10)

    # Normal (vertical dashed line)
    ax.plot([3, 3], [3, -1.5], color="#cc6677", lw=1.5, ls="--", alpha=0.7)
    ax.annotate("", xy=(3, 5.5), xytext=(3, 4.5),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2, color="#cc6677"))
    ax.text(3.15, 5.3, r"$\hat N$", color="#cc6677", fontsize=12)

    # Draw incoming ball and trajectory
    theta_deg = 30
    theta = np.deg2rad(theta_deg)
    r = 3.0
    # Ball position on incoming path
    bx_in, by_in = 3 - r*np.sin(theta), 3 - r*np.cos(theta)
    # Impact point
    px, py = 3, 3
    # Direction of incoming velocity (30 deg to wall = 60 deg to normal)
    # wall is horizontal, normal is vertical. 30 deg to wall means 60 deg to normal.
    ax.plot([bx_in, px], [by_in, py], color="#4477aa", lw=2.5, ls="-")
    ax.annotate("", xy=(px, py), xytext=(bx_in, by_in),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2.5, color="#4477aa"))
    ax.plot(bx_in, by_in, "o", ms=8, color="#4477aa")
    ax.text(bx_in-1.2, by_in-0.3, r"$v = 10$ m/s", color="#4477aa", fontsize=11)

    # Angle arc (incoming) - 30 deg to wall
    arc_in = Arc((3, 3), 1.0, 1.0, angle=0, theta1=270, theta2=270+theta_deg,
                 color="#4477aa", lw=1.5)
    ax.add_patch(arc_in)
    ax.text(3+0.7*np.cos(np.deg2rad(285)), 3+0.7*np.sin(np.deg2rad(285)),
            r"$30°$", color="#4477aa", fontsize=10)

    # Draw outgoing ball and trajectory
    bx_out, by_out = 3 + r*np.sin(theta), 3 + r*np.cos(theta)
    ax.plot([px, bx_out], [py, by_out], color="#117733", lw=2.5, ls="-")
    ax.annotate("", xy=(bx_out, by_out), xytext=(px, py),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2.5, color="#117733"))
    ax.plot(bx_out, by_out, "o", ms=8, color="#117733")
    ax.text(bx_out+0.1, by_out-0.2, r"$v = 10$ m/s (same speed)", color="#117733", fontsize=10)

    # Angle arc (outgoing) - symmetric
    arc_out = Arc((3, 3), 1.3, 1.3, angle=0, theta1=270-theta_deg, theta2=270,
                  color="#117733", lw=1.5)
    ax.add_patch(arc_out)
    ax.text(3+1.0*np.cos(np.deg2rad(255)), 3+1.0*np.sin(np.deg2rad(255)),
            r"$30°$", color="#117733", fontsize=10)

    # Highlight: angle to NORMAL is 60 deg both sides (label it)
    ax.text(2.0, 4.5, r"$60°$ to normal (both sides)", color="grey", fontsize=9, style="italic")
    ax.text(2.0, 4.1, "symmetric about normal", color="grey", fontsize=9, style="italic")

    # Bottom labels
    ax.text(1.0, -0.5, "Incoming: $30°$ from wall surface", color="#4477aa", fontsize=10)
    ax.text(5.5, -0.5, "Outgoing: $30°$ from wall surface (reflected)", color="#117733", fontsize=10)
    ax.text(1.0, -1.2, "Speed unchanged — elastic reflection off fixed wall", color="grey", fontsize=9, style="italic")

    ax.set_title(r"Quiz 1C: Elastic reflection off a smooth wall\n"
                 r"Angle of incidence = angle of reflection (measured from surface)",
                 fontsize=11)
    fig.tight_layout()
    save(fig, "quiz_1c.png")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Quiz 2B: Two Projectiles — Separation
# Two balls launched from same point: A at 30°, B at 90°, both at 10 m/s.
# After 2s, distance = 20 m. Show relative velocity.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def fig_quiz2b():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.5))
    ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.axis("off")
    ax.set_xlim(-1, 10); ax.set_ylim(-2, 12)

    v0 = 10.0; g = 10.0
    angles = [30, 90]
    colors = ["#4477aa", "#117733"]
    labels = ["A: 30°", "B: 90° (straight up)"]
    t_end = 2.0

    for a, c, lbl in zip(angles, colors, labels):
        rad = np.deg2rad(a)
        t = np.linspace(0, t_end, 100)
        x = v0 * np.cos(rad) * t
        y = v0 * np.sin(rad) * t - 0.5 * g * t**2
        ax.plot(x, y, color=c, lw=2.5, label=f"{lbl} ({v0} m/s)")
        # Final position
        xf = v0 * np.cos(rad) * t_end
        yf = v0 * np.sin(rad) * t_end - 0.5 * g * t_end**2
        ax.plot(xf, yf, "o", ms=10, color=c)
        ax.text(xf+0.15, yf, f"({xf:.1f}, {yf:.1f})", fontsize=9, color=c)
        # Velocity vector at start
        ax.annotate("", xy=(v0*np.cos(rad), v0*np.sin(rad)), xytext=(0, 0),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2, color=c, alpha=0.5))

    # Launch point
    ax.plot(0, 0, "s", ms=12, color="black", zorder=10)
    ax.text(0.2, -0.5, "launch", fontsize=10)

    # Ground
    ax.axhline(0, color="black", lw=0.8, ls="-")
    ax.text(9.5, 0.2, "ground", fontsize=9, color="grey")

    # Draw relative velocity vector
    # v_rel = v_A - v_B = (v0*cos30 - 0, v0*sin30 - v0) = (5√3, -5)
    dx_rel = v0*np.cos(np.deg2rad(30)) - 0
    dy_rel = v0*np.sin(np.deg2rad(30)) - v0
    # Draw from B's endpoint to A's endpoint
    xa = v0*np.cos(np.deg2rad(30))*t_end
    ya = v0*np.sin(np.deg2rad(30))*t_end - 0.5*g*t_end**2
    xb = 0 * t_end  # B's x = 0
    yb = v0*t_end - 0.5*g*t_end**2  # B's y
    ax.annotate("", xy=(xa, ya), xytext=(xb, yb),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=3, color="#cc6677",
                                mutation_scale=20))
    # Mark separation
    sep = np.sqrt(dx_rel**2 + dy_rel**2) * t_end
    ax.text((xa+xb)/2+0.2, (ya+yb)/2+0.2,
            f"|Δv|={np.sqrt(dx_rel**2+dy_rel**2):.1f} m/s\n"
            f"sep after 2s: {sep:.0f} m",
            color="#cc6677", fontsize=10,
            bbox=dict(fc="#ffeeee", ec="#cc6677", alpha=0.8))

    # Gravity labels on trajectories
    ax.annotate("", xy=(0.5, 7.5), xytext=(0.5, 9.0),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=1, color="grey"))
    ax.text(0.6, 8.5, r"$g$ (same on both)", color="grey", fontsize=9)

    ax.legend(loc="upper right", fontsize=10)
    ax.set_title(r"Quiz 2B: Two projectiles from same point, same speed\n"
                 r"Gravity cancels in relative frame → constant relative velocity",
                 fontsize=11)
    fig.tight_layout()
    save(fig, "quiz_2b.png")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Quiz 2C: Two Projectiles — Never Collide
# Same speed, different angles: 30° and 45°. Show they diverge.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def fig_quiz2c():
    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5.5))

    v0 = 20.0; g = 10.0
    t_total = 3.0
    angles = [30, 45]
    colors = ["#4477aa", "#117733"]
    labels = [r"A: $30°$", r"B: $45°$"]

    # Left: trajectories
    ax1.set_aspect("equal"); ax1.axis("off")
    for a, c, lbl in zip(angles, colors, labels):
        rad = np.deg2rad(a)
        t = np.linspace(0, t_total, 300)
        x = v0 * np.cos(rad) * t
        y = v0 * np.sin(rad) * t - 0.5 * g * t**2
        y = np.maximum(y, -0.5)  # stop at ground
        ax1.plot(x, y, color=c, lw=2.5, label=lbl)
        # Peak marker
        t_peak = v0*np.sin(rad)/g
        x_peak = v0*np.cos(rad)*t_peak
        y_peak = v0*np.sin(rad)*t_peak - 0.5*g*t_peak**2
        ax1.plot(x_peak, y_peak, "o", color=c, ms=7)

    ax1.axhline(0, color="black", lw=0.8)
    ax1.plot(0, 0, "s", ms=12, color="black")
    ax1.text(0.2, -0.5, "launch", fontsize=10)
    ax1.legend(loc="upper right", fontsize=10)
    ax1.set_xlim(-1, 10); ax1.set_ylim(-2, 12)
    ax1.set_title("Trajectories (both land safely apart)", fontsize=10)

    # Right: y positions vs time
    for a, c, lbl in zip(angles, colors, labels):
        rad = np.deg2rad(a)
        t = np.linspace(0, t_total, 300)
        y = v0 * np.sin(rad) * t - 0.5 * g * t**2
        ax2.plot(t, y, color=c, lw=2.5, label=lbl)

    ax2.axhline(0, color="black", lw=0.8, ls="-")
    ax2.set_xlabel("time $t$ (s)")
    ax2.set_ylabel("$y$ (m)")
    ax2.legend(fontsize=10)
    ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)
    ax2.set_title("Vertical positions vs time\nB always above A after $t=0$", fontsize=10)

    # Relative y: B starts at same height but has higher vy → stays above
    fig.suptitle(r"Quiz 2C: Same speed, B at steeper angle → B always above A → they never meet",
                 fontsize=11)
    fig.tight_layout()
    save(fig, "quiz_2c.png")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Quiz 3A: Torque on a Seesaw
# 30kg child 2m left of pivot, find where 60kg child sits on right.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def fig_quiz3a():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4.5))
    ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.axis("off")
    ax.set_xlim(-5, 7); ax.set_ylim(-1.5, 4)

    # Seesaw beam
    beam_y = 0
    ax.plot([-4.5, 4.5], [beam_y, beam_y], color="#8B4513", lw=6, solid_capstyle="round")
    ax.plot([-4.5, 4.5], [beam_y, beam_y], color="#A0522D", lw=4)

    # Pivot triangle
    pivot_x = 0
    triangle = Polygon([[-0.5, beam_y-0.3], [0.5, beam_y-0.3], [0, beam_y-0.9]],
                       closed=True, fc="#888888", ec="black", lw=1.2)
    ax.add_patch(triangle)
    ax.text(0, beam_y-1.1, "pivot", ha="center", fontsize=10)

    # Left child (30 kg, 2m left)
    cx1 = -2.0; m1 = 30
    ax.add_patch(Circle((cx1, 1.0), 0.35, fc="#4477aa", ec="black", lw=1.5))
    ax.text(cx1, 1.55, f"{m1} kg", ha="center", fontsize=10)
    ax.annotate("", xy=(cx1, 0.05), xytext=(cx1, 1.0),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=1.5, color="black"))
    ax.text(cx1+0.1, 0.4, "2 m", fontsize=9)
    ax.text(cx1-0.55, 1.55, r"$r_1 = 2$ m", fontsize=9)

    # Right child (60 kg, x m right) — x = 1 m
    cx2 = 1.0; m2 = 60
    ax.add_patch(Circle((cx2, 1.0), 0.45, fc="#cc6677", ec="black", lw=1.5))
    ax.text(cx2, 1.65, f"{m2} kg", ha="center", fontsize=10)
    ax.annotate("", xy=(cx2, 0.05), xytext=(cx2, 1.0),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=1.5, color="black"))
    ax.text(cx2+0.1, 0.4, "1 m", fontsize=9)
    ax.text(cx2+0.5, 1.65, r"$r_2 = 1$ m", fontsize=9)

    # Torque arrows (curved, showing rotation)
    ax.annotate("", xy=(-2.4, 1.1), xytext=(-2.0, 1.1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2.5, color="#4477aa",
                                connectionstyle="arc3,rad=-0.8"))
    ax.text(-3.0, 1.5, r"$\tau_1 = 30·2 = 60\,g$", color="#4477aa", fontsize=11)

    ax.annotate("", xy=(1.6, 1.1), xytext=(1.0, 1.1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2.5, color="#cc6677",
                                connectionstyle="arc3,rad=+0.8"))
    ax.text(1.7, 1.5, r"$\tau_2 = 60·1 = 60\,g$", color="#cc6677", fontsize=11)

    ax.text(0, 3.2, r"Torque balance: $\tau_1 = \tau_2 \Rightarrow 30 \times 2 = 60 \times x \Rightarrow x = 1$ m",
            ha="center", fontsize=11,
            bbox=dict(fc="#ffffcc", ec="#888888", alpha=0.9))

    ax.set_title("Quiz 3A: Seesaw Torque Balance", fontsize=12)
    fig.tight_layout()
    save(fig, "quiz_3a.png")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Quiz 3B: Slide vs Topple
# Cube 1×1m, mu=0.5, slides at tan^-1(0.5) ≈ 26.6°, topples at 45°.
# Show both conditions.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def fig_quiz3b():
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.2))

    for ax, title_str, theta_deg, condition in [
        (axes[0], r"Sliding: $\tan\theta > \mu = 0.5$", 26.6, "slide"),
        (axes[1], r"Toppling: $\tan\theta > w/h = 1$", 45, "topple"),
    ]:
        ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.axis("off")
        th = np.deg2rad(theta_deg)
        L = 6

        # Incline
        incline = Polygon([[0,0],[L,0],[L, L*np.tan(th)]], closed=True,
                          fc="#dddddd", ec="black", lw=1)
        ax.add_patch(incline)

        # Cube on incline
        w, hb = 1.0, 1.0
        cx, cy = L*0.5, L*0.5*np.tan(th)
        local = np.array([[-w/2, 0],[w/2, 0],[w/2, hb],[-w/2, hb]])
        R = np.array([[np.cos(th), -np.sin(th)],[np.sin(th), np.cos(th)]])
        world = (local @ R.T) + np.array([cx, cy])
        ax.add_patch(Polygon(world, closed=True, fc="#ffeebb", ec="black", lw=1.2))

        # CoM
        com_local = np.array([0, hb/2])
        com_world = (R @ com_local) + np.array([cx, cy])
        ax.plot(*com_world, "o", color="#cc3333", ms=7)
        ax.text(com_world[0]+0.1, com_world[1]+0.1, "CoM", fontsize=9, color="#cc3333")

        # Vertical line from CoM
        ax.plot([com_world[0], com_world[0]],
                [com_world[1], com_world[1]-hb*1.5], "--", color="#cc3333", lw=1.2)

        # Front edge (for topple check)
        front = (R @ np.array([w/2, 0])) + np.array([cx, cy])
        ax.plot(*front, "s", color="#cc3333", ms=7)

        # Arc for angle
        arc = Arc((L, 0), 1.5, 1.5, angle=0, theta1=180-theta_deg, theta2=180, color="black")
        ax.add_patch(arc)
        ax.text(L-2.0, 0.2, f"$\\theta={theta_deg:.1f}°$\n$\\tan\\theta={np.tan(th):.2f}$",
                fontsize=10)

        ax.plot([-0.5, L+0.5], [0,0], color="black", lw=1)
        ax.set_xlim(-1, L+1.5); ax.set_ylim(-0.8, L*np.tan(th)+hb+1.0)
        ax.set_title(title_str, fontsize=10)

        if condition == "slide":
            ax.text(L/2, L*np.tan(th)+hb+0.4,
                    r"$\tan26.6° = 0.5 = \mu$ → sliding threshold",
                    ha="center", fontsize=9, color="#4477aa")
        else:
            ax.text(L/2, L*np.tan(th)+hb+0.4,
                    r"$\tan45° = 1 = w/h$ → toppling threshold",
                    ha="center", fontsize=9, color="#cc6677")

    fig.suptitle("Quiz 3B: Cube 1×1 m on frictional incline (μ=0.5)\n"
                 "Slides first at θ≈26.6°, topples later at θ=45°",
                 fontsize=11, y=1.02)
    fig.tight_layout()
    save(fig, "quiz_3b.png")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Quiz 3C: Ladder Against Wall
# Ladder at 60°, person climbs. FBD diagram.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def fig_quiz3c():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))
    ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.axis("off")

    # Incline
    incline = Polygon([[0,0],[L,0],[L, L*np.tan(th)]], closed=True,
                      fc="#dddddd", ec="black")
    ax.add_patch(incline)

    w, hb = 1.2, 0.9
    cx, cy = L*0.55, L*0.55*np.tan(th)
    local = np.array([[-w/2, 0],[w/2, 0],[w/2, hb],[-w/2, hb]])
    R = np.array([[np.cos(th), -np.sin(th)],[np.sin(th), np.cos(th)]])
    world = (local @ R.T) + np.array([cx, cy])
    ax.add_patch(Polygon(world, closed=True, fc="#ffeebb", ec="black"))

    # CoM
    com = (R @ np.array([0, hb/2])) + np.array([cx, cy])
    ax.plot(*com, "o", color="black", ms=5)

    # Applied horizontal force F = 50 N
    F = 50.0
    # F decomposed along and perpendicular to incline
    F_along = F * np.cos(th)   # F cos30 = 43.3 N (positive, up incline)
    F_perp = F * np.sin(th)   # F sin30 = 25 N (into surface)
    F_along_vec = R @ np.array([-F_along, 0])  # negative = up incline
    ax.annotate("", xy=(com[0]+F_along_vec[0], com[1]+F_along_vec[1]),
                xytext=com,
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2.5, color="#4477aa"))
    ax.text(com[0]+F_along_vec[0]-0.5, com[1]+F_along_vec[1]+0.2,
            f"$F\\cos\\theta={F_along:.1f}$ N", color="#4477aa", fontsize=10)

    # Gravity along incline
    g_along = 5 * 9.8 * np.sin(th)  # = 24.5 N down incline

    ax.annotate("", xy=(com[0]+g_along_vec[0], com[1]+g_along_vec[1]),
                xytext=com,

    ax.text(com[0]+g_along_vec[0]+0.1, com[1]+g_along_vec[1]-0.4,
            f"$mg\\sin\\theta={g_along:.1f}$ N", color="#cc3333", fontsize=9)

    # Friction
    f = 35.0  # expected answer
    f_vec = R @ np.array([f, 0])  # down incline
    ax.annotate("", xy=(com[0]+f_vec[0], com[1]+f_vec[1]),

    ax.add_patch(arc)
    ax.text(L-2.0, 0.2, f"$\\theta={th_deg}°$", fontsize=10)

    ax1.set_title(r"Quiz 7A: Forces on Incline\n$F=50$ N horizontal, $m=5$ kg, $d=2$ m, $\Delta v: 0\to1$ m/s",

    ax.set_title("Work-Energy Theorem:\n$W_F + W_g + W_f = \\Delta K$", fontsize=10)
    ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)

    # Mark W_f = -35 J on the bar

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Quiz 8A: Centrifuge Effective Gravity
# f=100 Hz, r=5cm → a_c ≈ 1.97×10⁴ m/s²
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def fig_quiz8a():
    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.5))

    # Left: centrifuge cross-section
    ax = ax1
    ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.axis("off")
    ax.set_xlim(-4, 4); ax.set_ylim(-4, 4)

    # Rotating drum (circle)
    drum = Circle((0, 0), 3.0, fc="none", ec="#555555", lw=3)
    ax.add_patch(drum)
    # Rotation arrows
    for angle in [30, 90, 150, 210, 270, 330]:
        rad = np.deg2rad(angle)
        x1, y1 = 3.0*np.cos(rad), 3.0*np.sin(rad)
        dx, dy = 0.4*np.cos(rad+np.pi/2), 0.4*np.sin(rad+np.pi/2)
        ax.annotate("", xy=(x1+dx, y1+dy), xytext=(x1, y1),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2, color="#4477aa"))
    ax.text(0, 0.05, "rotating", ha="center", fontsize=10, color="#555555")

    # Sample at r = 0.05 m (scaled to 2 cm on diagram)
    r_display = 1.8
    ax.add_patch(Circle((r_display, 0), 0.25, fc="#cc6677", ec="black", lw=1.5))
    ax.plot([0, r_display], [0, 0], "--", color="grey", lw=1)
    ax.text(r_display+0.35, 0.3, f"$r = 5$ cm\n$f = 100$ Hz", fontsize=10)

    # Effective gravity arrow (radial, outward)
    ax.annotate("", xy=(r_display+0.8, 0), xytext=(r_display+0.25, 0),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=3, color="#cc3333"))
    ax.text(r_display+1.0, 0.15, r"$a_c = \omega^2 r$", color="#cc3333", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")

    # Arrow pointing toward center (centripetal = real force)
    ax.annotate("", xy=(r_display-0.8, 0), xytext=(r_display-0.25, 0),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2, color="#4477aa"))
    ax.text(r_display-1.5, -0.3, r"$\vec a_c$\n(radial inward)", color="#4477aa", fontsize=9)

    ax1.set_title(r"Quiz 8A: Centrifuge Cross-Section", fontsize=11)

    # Right: calculation
    ax = ax2
    ax.axis("off")
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10); ax.set_ylim(0, 8)

    f = 100.0; r = 0.05; omega = 2*np.pi*f
    a_c = omega**2 * r

    lines = [
        (r"$f = 100$ Hz, $r = 0.05$ m", 6.5, 14),
        (r"$\omega = 2\pi f = 2\pi \times 100 = 200\pi$ rad/s", 5.5, 12),
        (r"$\omega^2 = (200\pi)^2 \approx 3.95 \times 10^5$ rad²/s²", 4.5, 10),
        (r"$a_c = \omega^2 r = 3.95 \times 10^5 \times 0.05$", 3.5, 8),
        (rf"$\approx {a_c:.2f} \times 10^4$ m/s²", 2.5, 6, "#cc3333", True),
        (rf"$\approx {a_c/9.8:.0f}\,g$", 1.5, 4, "#cc3333", True),
        (r"$g_\text{eff} \approx 2{,}000\,g$!", 0.5, 2, "#cc3333", True),
    ]

    for item in lines:
        if len(item) == 3:
            text, y, fs = item
            color = "black"
        else:
            text, y, fs, color, _ = item
        ax.text(0.5, y, text, fontsize=fs, color=color, va="center")

    for y in [6, 4, 2]:
        ax.axhline(y, color="grey", lw=0.5)

    ax2.set_title("Quiz 8A: Calculation", fontsize=11)

    fig.suptitle("Quiz 8A: Centrifuge Effective Gravity\n"
                 f"100 Hz at 5 cm radius → $a_c \\approx 1.97 \\times 10^4$ m/s² (≈2000g)",
                 fontsize=11, y=1.02)
    fig.tight_layout()
    save(fig, "quiz_8a.png")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Quiz 9A: Gravity Assist
# Spacecraft +10 km/s, Jupiter -13 km/s → exit at 36 km/s
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def fig_quiz9a():
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14, 4.5))

    titles = ["In Sun's Frame\n(before)", "In Jupiter's Frame\n(elastic bounce)",
              "In Sun's Frame\n(after)"]
    texts = [
        (r"Spacecraft: $v_i = +10$ km/s $\to$", 0.5, 4.0, "#4477aa"),
        (r"Jupiter: $v_p = -13$ km/s $\gets$", 0.5, 3.2, "#cc6677"),
        (r"Relative: $u = 10 - (-13) = 23$ km/s", 0.5, 2.2, "#117733"),
    ]

    for idx, (ax, title) in enumerate(zip(axes, titles)):
        ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.axis("off")
        ax.set_xlim(-1, 8); ax.set_ylim(-1, 5)

        if idx == 0:
            # Before: spacecraft approaching Jupiter
            ax.add_patch(Circle((5.5, 2.0), 0.8, fc="#cc6677", ec="black", lw=1.5))
            ax.text(5.5, 2.0, "Jupiter", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8, color="white")
            # Jupiter velocity arrow (left)
            ax.annotate("", xy=(4.5, 2.0), xytext=(5.5, 2.0),
                        arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2.5, color="#cc6677"))
            ax.text(4.0, 2.3, r"$v_p = -13$ km/s", color="#cc6677", fontsize=10)
            # Spacecraft arrow (right, toward Jupiter)
            ax.annotate("", xy=(5.2, 2.5), xytext=(1.0, 2.5),
                        arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2.5, color="#4477aa"))
            ax.text(1.2, 2.75, r"$v_i = +10$ km/s", color="#4477aa", fontsize=10)
            ax.text(0.5, 4.0, "Before encounter", fontsize=10, style="italic")
        elif idx == 1:
            # In Jupiter frame: 180° bounce
            ax.add_patch(Circle((3.5, 2.0), 0.8, fc="#cc6677", ec="black", lw=1.5))
            ax.text(3.5, 2.0, "Jupiter\n(at rest)", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8, color="white")
            # Incoming arrow
            ax.annotate("", xy=(3.2, 2.0), xytext=(1.0, 2.0),
                        arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2.5, color="#4477aa"))
            ax.text(1.0, 2.3, r"$u_{\rm in} = 23$ km/s", color="#4477aa", fontsize=10)
            # Outgoing arrow (reversed)
            ax.annotate("", xy=(1.0, 2.0), xytext=(3.2, 2.0),
                        arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2.5, color="#117733"))
            ax.text(1.0, 1.6, r"$u_{\rm out} = 23$ km/s (flipped)", color="#117733", fontsize=9)
            ax.text(3.5, 3.5, "Speed unchanged!\nOnly direction flips", ha="center",
                    fontsize=9, style="italic", color="grey")
        else:
            # After: spacecraft exits with Jupiter's motion
            ax.add_patch(Circle((1.0, 2.0), 0.8, fc="#cc6677", ec="black", lw=1.5))
            ax.text(1.0, 2.0, "Jupiter", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8, color="white")
            # Jupiter velocity
            ax.annotate("", xy=(0.2, 2.0), xytext=(1.0, 2.0),
                        arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2.5, color="#cc6677"))
            ax.text(-0.3, 2.3, r"$v_p = -13$ km/s", color="#cc6677", fontsize=10)
            # Spacecraft now moving left with Jupiter
            ax.annotate("", xy=(0.0, 2.8), xytext=(1.5, 2.8),
                        arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=2.5, color="#117733"))
            ax.text(0.2, 3.1,
                    r"$v_f = |-23 + (-13)| = 36$ km/s",
                    color="#117733", fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")
            ax.text(4.0, 3.5,
                    r"$v_f = u_{\rm out} + v_p = 23 + 13 = 36$ km/s",
                    fontsize=10, color="#117733",
                    bbox=dict(fc="#eeffee", ec="#117733", alpha=0.9))

        ax.set_title(title, fontsize=10)

    fig.suptitle("Quiz 9A: Gravity Assist — Speed Gain\n"
                 "Jupiter reverses spacecraft direction, adding Jupiter's own speed",
                 fontsize=11, y=1.02)
    fig.tight_layout()
    save(fig, "quiz_9a.png")
